summary: Multi-branch session-message command handler keyed on the type selector at this+0x304. Types 432 and 434 copy the string at this+0x2F0 into a global track buffer (25 or 31 bytes) and clear a trailing flag byte. Type 435 verifies session state and object ownership, then encodes a progress-bar event, copies the message string, creates a texture, builds a path buffer from byte_5EA438, and dispatches the session state. Every path ends by calling the vtable slot at +168 on this.
